services.name: Why Charter
services.desc: When making plans to travel, there are a number of different options that can get you there. Traveling using a commercial airline has been the most widely selected option in the past, but private jet charters are gaining in popularity. Many private charter clients will tell you that the benefits of private aviation far outnumber those of commercial air travel. Commercial air travel has become increasingly complicated and time consuming in recent years. Due to heightened security measures, travelers are required to arrive several hours early and spend the time undergoing various checks and screenings that can be annoying and inconvenient.
